# AHW Architects

> AHW Architects is a multidisciplinary Architecture, Interior Design, Engineering, and Design & Build practice headquartered in Kuwait City, with an office in Cairo, Egypt, delivering projects across Egypt, Kuwait, and the wider Gulf Cooperation Council region.

AHW Architects operates as an integrated Design & Build firm: the same team carries a project from architectural concept through construction and handover, across five core disciplines — Architecture, Interior Design, Engineering & Project Management, Design & Build, and Fit-Out. Project sectors include Residential, Commercial, Hospitality, Workplace, and Retail.
